title: Fat loss, full gym, 5 days
message: I'm 29 and I've trained casually for about a year. I want to lose about 8 kg of fat while keeping my muscle. I can train 5 days a week, up to 60 minutes, in a full commercial gym: barbells, dumbbells, cables, machines, treadmill, bike and rower. No injuries.

checks.why: fat loss and health need at least 150 minutes of cardio a week
